articulation.label: form
articulation.alt: form: /f/ → /ɔ/ → /r/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
